11:13
Lucy
•
AI Agent

Yes, we’re super excited to say we do ship internationally! Our beautiful custom jewellery can reach you almost anywhere in the world. Here’s a quick rundown on customs and duties:

For most European countries (like the UK, France, Germany, Spain, and more), import taxes and duties are included in the price—so there are no extra charges when your order arrives.
For the USA, from 16 May 2025, a 30% tariff will apply to your purchase due to new government regulations. These charges go directly to the US government and are the customer’s responsibility.
For the rest of the world, any customs charges are set by your local carrier and laws, and you’ll need to cover those fees.

If you want all the details, you can check out our full shipping policy right here: https://www.abbottlyon.com/pages/shipping

We’re so excited for you to receive your gorgeous Abbott Lyon pieces, wherever you are! 🧡

turns.replyTail:
cy
•

Standard shipping times depend on the type of item:

Non-custom items: Usually dispatched within one working day and take 6–9 working days for delivery.
Custom items: Typically take 2–3 weeks for creation before dispatch, and delivery times will be shown on the product page and at checkout.

You’ll receive tracking details once your order ships, but it may take up to 48 hours for tracking to update. For more details, check out our shipping policy here. 😊
